reviewer: Claude (Anthropic), visual review of contact sheets
method: Candidates = photographs in the Wikimedia Commons category of the card's own Wikidata item and its direct sub-categories, free licenses only, at least 1200 px, near-duplicates of the cover removed. Each was viewed on a labelled contact sheet beside the card's cover and approved only when it shows the site itself and adds a viewpoint the cover and the other approved images do not (setting, plan, interior, detail, another monument of the complex).
